map.evidence: board.jpg and battle.jpg minimap show the four-loop clover route with a centre cell; only DMP 0172 (104 cells) has that shape among the 26 source maps

method: OpenCV TM_CCOEFF_NORMED with the native 145x97 TIS alpha mask (alpha>200), sprite rows reversed (the PNG export is stored bottom-up), scale 1:1. 'global' = best match over the whole 800x600 capture; 'local' = best match within +-60 px of the hex formula prediction. tools/brd01_measure_board_jpg.py reproduces every number.

projection.grid: odd-q flat-top hex: odd DMP columns sit half a row lower
projection.level: VERIFIED (screenshot anchors + route structure + sprite tessellation)
projection.routeStructure: 451 of 452 diagonal route steps in all 26 DMP maps go down from odd columns / up from even columns (only exception: 0193 step 24, a jump); even-q would contradict 450 of them
projection.tessellation: at 105x80 with a 40 px odd-column drop the 145x97 TIS top faces meet edge to edge; nearer cells cover only the 17 px side faces

occluded: cells 18, 19, 22 and the rest of the view are covered by the BATTLE overlay, podiums, dice and the right UI column in both captures; no other board-state capture exists in the repository (dice_ref*.png are lobby backgrounds)
